defect: The fix only moves the closing brace of the value_map initializer onto the previous line (clang-format).
reason: Pure formatting change; the merge-resolved initializer compiled and behaved the same before and after.

defect: The change introduces probe_sel_count as a member counter of the shared PerfectHashJoinExecutor that every probe call increments (and never resets), so it accumulates across chunks and races between threads.
reason: The fix turns probe_sel_count into a per-call local passed by reference, repairing exactly the shared counter this change added in TemplatedFillSelectionVectorProbe and ProbePerfectHashTable.

defect: The fix removes the probe_sel_count member and passes it per call to make probing thread safe.
reason: This change only created a stub header without probe_sel_count; the shared counter was added later in 89d3e74.

defect: The fix adapts to func.functions having become a ScalarFunctionSet by calling GetFunction instead of operator[].
reason: At this change func.functions was a vector<ScalarFunction>, so the code compiled; the build break came from a later API change elsewhere.

defect: The new LOGICAL_CTE_REF case reads base_binding.column_index from cteref.types.size() and pushes correlated types into types (and the recursive CTE case into setop.types), although LogicalCTERef derives types from chunk_types in ResolveTypes, so the index can be wrong (types may be unresolved) and types get duplicated.
reason: The same-day fix switches to chunk_types.size() and drops the types pushes, repairing lines this change added; seeing it needs LogicalCTERef's ResolveTypes.

defect: The new GetDate computes timestamp / MICROS_PER_DAY - (timestamp < 0), which gives one day too early for negative timestamps that lie exactly on a day boundary.
reason: The fix changes the formula to (timestamp + (timestamp < 0)) / MICROS_PER_DAY - (timestamp < 0), correcting the floor division this change introduced.

defect: The fix rewrites epoch_ms and to_timestamp on top of Timestamp::FromEpochMs/FromEpochSeconds after the timestamp representation changed to microseconds.
reason: The date/ms-time construction it replaces predates this change and broke when d17fc74 changed the timestamp encoding without updating epoch.cpp; this change only added the template factor and the alias.

defect: The fix stops planning non-combinable aggregates as simple aggregates (whose Combine moved and overwrote the global state across pipelines) and makes ParallelSink always true.
reason: The added ParallelSink returning all_combinable preserves the parallelism rule previously in pipeline.cpp; the overwriting Move-based Combine and the multi-pipeline union were not introduced by these header lines.

defect: The fix moves the RAII wrapper classes and the capi_internal include into adbc.hpp inside duckdb_adbc for the amalgamation build, plus a cast and a redundant check cleanup.
reason: The wrapper classes and include that clash in the amalgamation were already present before this change, which only added schema release and dropped two release resets.

defect: The new test frees out_names[i], which arrow_to_duckdb_schema allocates with new char[], using free(), an allocation/deallocation mismatch (undefined behaviour flagged by sanitizers).
reason: The fix replaces those free calls with delete in the test lines this change added (its change of free on strdup memory is itself questionable); seeing the mismatch needs arrow-c.cpp.

defect: The fix removes the OnSet validation callback of debug_physical_table_scan_execution_strategy and registers it as a plain setting.
reason: OnSet was declared and defined in this commit, so nothing was broken; the fix is a review cleanup.

defect: The fix rewords docstrings (Data.Frame to DataFrame) and removes a duplicate df definition.
reason: Documentation and cleanup only; the duplicate df definition already existed before this change.

defect: The fix rewords the fetchdf/fetch_df/df docstrings and reflows their argument lists.
reason: Documentation and formatting change; it repairs no behaviour from this change.

defect: The fix renames variables, rewrites the struct loop index arithmetic equivalently and adds MapConversionVerify in a multi-row implementation written after this change.
reason: The single-row code of this change had already been replaced by later commits, and the fix touches none of its lines in a corrective way.

defect: The new RemoveDirectory calls fsspec rmdir, which only removes empty directories, whereas DuckDB's RemoveDirectory contract is a recursive removal.
reason: The fix replaces it with rm(directory, recursive=True), repairing the method this change added; the contract is defined by the FileSystem interface and local implementation.

defect: The fix changes the default join_ref_type of CrossProduct from REGULAR to CROSS.
reason: This change only renamed the parameter; the REGULAR default was already there before it.

defect: The fix comments out large parts of the relation API tests and tweaks the cross product test setup while debugging.
reason: A work-in-progress test change, not the repair of a defect in the added test lines.

defect: The fix ranks SELECT above FROM in keyword suggestions and stops clearing suggestions when the last word is empty.
reason: Giving FROM the same score as SELECT is a ranking choice, and the empty-word all_of bug came from a later commit (979b9993bd3), not this change.

defect: The declared OptimizeLargeLimit(child) lets late materialization fire for arbitrarily large limits and for offset-less limits without preserve_insertion_order, causing the memory and performance problem of #16278.
reason: The fix changes this declaration to take the limit, its value and has_offset, but the logic lives in the .cpp and it is unclear whether #16278 is a correctness failure (OOM) or only a performance regression.

defect: The fix delegates the BlockManager Block constructor to the FileBuffer constructor taking the block manager, to satisfy clang-tidy.
reason: Tidy-driven refactor; both forms pass the same block size and header size.

defect: The fix frees the previously held non-inlined string in StringMinMaxBase::Assign, which leaked every time a new min/max replaced it.
reason: The leaking Assign (allocate a copy without freeing the old one) existed before this change, which only moved the value into a state struct; the isset reordering is needed only for the new Destroy call.

defect: SHOW TABLES was rewritten to read only duckdb_tables (column table_name), dropping the views and indexes that sqlite_master listed and renaming the result column.
reason: The same-day fix unions tables, views and indexes again under the column name, repairing the regression in the line this change added.

defect: The fix checks each distinct target instead of only the first, rescopes could_add, and adds braces around the switch cases.
reason: The DISTINCT and projection code it corrects was written after this change, and the braces only restyle an equivalent switch.

defect: The new aggregate cardinality estimate uses grouping-set indexes (positions in aggr.groups) as indexes into the child's column_distinct_count, yielding wrong estimates or out-of-range access.
reason: The same-day fix maps each group through its BoundColumnRef binding column_index; knowing that grouping sets index aggr.groups needs LogicalAggregate.

defect: The fix removes the debug D_ASSERT(false) in the non-prefetched read fallback, prefetches a larger fallback range, merges ClearPrefetch and reorders members to silence -Wreorder.
reason: The multi-file failure came from stale have_prefetched_group state in parquet_reader.cpp; here the fix drops a deliberate debug assertion and fixes a member-order warning that predated this change.

defect: The activated whole-row-group prefetch skips prefetching when have_prefetched_group is set and prefetched_group equals the current group index, state that is never reset when the scan state moves to another file, so the next file's group is not prefetched after the buffers were cleared.
reason: The fix resets have_prefetched_group on every group switch and drops the prefetched_group comparison this change introduced; seeing it needs the multi-file reuse of the scan state.

defect: The fix replaces memcpy of +00 with three character writes to appease clang-tidy.
reason: Both forms write the same three bytes; the change is tool-driven style.

defect: The fix qualifies move as std::move.
reason: Lint-only change with identical behaviour.

defect: The fix qualifies move as std::move in ReadJSON.
reason: Lint-only change in code rewritten after this change; no behaviour changes.

defect: The fix returns a TimestampCastResult so plain casts accept a UTC zone name and report a clearer error for other zones, and lets ICU override the cast.
reason: Before this change a trailing zone name was also rejected, so this is a feature and error-message improvement rather than repair of a regression from these lines.

defect: The fix adds TimestampCastResult and UnsupportedTimezoneError declarations and changes TryConvertTimestamp's return type.
reason: API extension for the #6253 feature; this change only reordered declarations so the header compiles.

defect: The change adds D_ASSERT(left_bindings_actual.size() == right_bindings_actual.size()), which fails for valid semi/anti joins whose children have different column counts.
reason: The next-day fix comments the assertion out (and additionally stops pushing filters into the right side of anti joins, a pre-existing problem); the assertion is plainly too strong from the diff.

defect: pragma_last_profiling_output reports context.query and context.profiler.main_query (the current pragma query) instead of the previous profiled query held in prev_profiler.
reason: The fix switches the first row to prev_profiler.query and prev_profiler.main_query, matching the prev_profiler used for the operator rows in the same function.

defect: ParquetProgress divides a chunk count accumulated over all files by the first file's row count, so multi-file scans report progress far above 100 percent.
reason: The fix tracks the current file, resets chunk_count per file and scales by the number of files, repairing the progress formula this change added.

defect: Enum names were changed from a UUID to __pivot_enum_<pivot_entries.size()>_<c>, but in a child transformer the entries go to the parent, so the local count stays 0 and several pivots (e.g. in a join) get the same enum name, the later one replacing the earlier.
reason: The fix uses PivotEntryCount(), which delegates to the parent, for the name this change introduced; AddPivotEntry's delegation is visible in the diff.

defect: The PIVOT check was added only in TransformSelect, so pivots reached through TransformSelectNode directly (set operations, COPY, SHOW) are transformed as ordinary selects and the pivot is ignored.
reason: The fix moves the pivot dispatch into TransformSelectNode so every caller handles it; seeing the gap needs the other TransformSelectNode callers.

defect: The fix makes COPY FROM JSON auto-detect the format instead of assuming newline-delimited.
reason: The NEWLINE_DELIMITED default for COPY was already there before this change, which only renamed the access path.

defect: The fix parses the .tables pattern with QualifiedName::ParseComponents to support quoted identifiers and invalid patterns instead of splitting at the first dot.
reason: This extends the new schema-qualified filter to quoted identifiers (an enhancement), not the repair of a crash or wrong result for the inputs the change supported.

defect: The fix only reflows declarations and fixes reference spacing in the header.
reason: The header change in the fix is pure formatting; the MSVC include fixes are in the .cpp.

defect: The fix adds includes needed by MSVC and reformats comments and calls.
reason: This change only reflowed comments and lines; the missing includes date from the original commit 7896de2, not from these lines.
